# Contributing to BitDesigners Africa

Thank you for your interest in contributing.
BitDesigners Africa is a Bitcoin-only learning
platform for African designers. We welcome
contributions that align with that mission.

## Before You Start

- Read the README to understand the project
- Check open issues before starting new work
- For large changes, open an issue first to
  discuss before writing code

## Branch Naming

Use this format for all branches:
  feat/short-description
  fix/short-description
  docs/short-description
  chore/short-description

Examples:
  feat/lesson-page-mobile
  fix/admin-invite-border
  docs/update-contributing

## Pull Requests

- One PR per feature or fix
- Keep PRs small and focused
- Fill out the PR template completely
- Link to the related issue if one exists
- Screenshots required for UI changes

## Commit Messages

Follow Conventional Commits format:
  feat: add mission submission form
  fix: correct pill border on invites page
  docs: update README setup instructions
  chore: add MIT license

## Design System

All UI contributions must follow the design
system documented in docs/design-system.md.
Non-negotiables:
- Dark theme #090909 background
- Indigo #6366F1 for interactive elements only
- Orange #F7931A for Bitcoin content only
- JetBrains Mono for all data and labels
- No colored card borders
- No scale/lift on card hover

## Code Standards

- TypeScript — no any types
- No console.log in committed code
- Components must be mobile-responsive
- Test on 390px viewport before submitting

## Questions

Open a GitHub Discussion or reach out on
Discord before opening a PR for major changes.
